title: Jammy Venezuelan Soy Sauce Quick-Fix
description: A velvety, jammy dish featuring the bold flavors of Venezuela and the umami taste of soy sauce. This vegan-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potatoes and boil them in a large pot of salted water until tender.
Meanwhile, heat the vegan butter in a large skillet over medium heat and cook until melted.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine, then add the cooked sweet potatoes and toss until the sweet potatoes are well coated with the sauce.
Transfer the sweet potatoes to a serving dish, top with chopped cilantro, and serve hot.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
This recipe can be adjusted to serve more or fewer people by adjusting the amount of sweet potatoes and soy sauce used.
